page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with no marginal notes. Running head "CAPVT XI." at the top, page number "57" at the top right. Signature "D v" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: rum ciuitatum longitudines referre ad Arim, quàm ad infulas fortunatas, quas incultas & defertas cenfe-bant, & ad quas nullæ erant factæ tabulæ. Exempla obuia funt in canonibus Arzachelis, qui pulcherrime in membrana defcripti extant in bibliotheca Palati-na: vt cûm dicitur, hos canones reductos effe ad me-ridianum Toleti, cuius longitudo ab Arim comple-ctatur fpacium 4 horarum & 1/10 vnius horæ, & latitu-do ab æquinoctiali fit 39 grad.& 54 minutorum. Vni horæ refpondent 1 5 gradus, ergo 4 horæ, cum 1/10 co-ficiunt 61 1/6 gradus: quæ eft diftantia Toleti ab Arim: fi fubtrahantur 61 1/6 gradus à 90 gradibus, reftant 28 1/2 gradus, quæ eft diftantia Toleti ab infulis fortu-natis : quam etiam ponit Iudæus quidã in t[?]actatu de aftrolabio: fi à 28 1/3 gradibus, auferantur decem gra-dus, tunc iuxta fententiam Abilfedæ remanebunt 18 1/3 gradus: quæ debebat effe diftantia Toleti à littore oceani occidentalis. Sed Abilfedea afferit Toletum fecudum Aben Sahid à littore maris occidentalis ab-effe 15 1/2 gradus: quæ fententia veritati magis eft con-fentanea. In iisdem Arzachelis canonibus fcribitur, vrbem Parisiorum habere longitudinem ab Arim 48 graduum, & 30 minutorum: & à Toleto longitudi-nem habere 10 graduum, altitudinem folis in meri-die, quado fol fit in principio arietis effe 41 grad. & 25 minutorum: hoc eft, altitudinem poli effe 48 graduu & 35 minutorum: adiicitur tamen quod ciuitas Pari-fiorum diftet à ciuitate Toleti fecundum quofdam 11 gradibus & 30 minutis, hoc eft 46 minutis horæ, fe-cundum alios diftet 12 gradibus, & 17 minutis, hoc eft 49 minutis horæ,& 8 fecundis, fecundum alios 11

page.notes: Fractions are written as printed in simplified form (1/10, 1/6, 1/3, 1/2); the scan's small fraction glyphs are not reproduced exactly. The word "tractatu" after "in t" is blurred and read as uncertain. "graduu" at the line end and "fecudum" are kept as printed. Some numerals in the line "cum 1/10 co-ficiunt 61" and in "15 1/2" are approximate readings of small type.
